cohort: 100 parturients with term pregnancy (>=36 weeks), ASA physical status II, aged 18-35 years, scheduled for low-risk elective caesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Intrathecal 1% 2-chloroprocaine (30 mg) with fentanyl (25 mug) resulted in a longer duration of sensory blockade and postoperative analgesia compared to 1% 2-chloroprocaine (30 mg) alone, with similar motor blockade duration and complication rates.
